# Laravel Cacheable

Attribute-driven method caching for Laravel 10/11/12/13. Annotate any method
with `#[Cacheable]` and the package handles TTL, tags, locking, stale-while-
revalidate, and invalidation automatically.

## Installation

```bash
composer require aftandilmmd/laravel-cacheable
php artisan vendor:publish --tag=cacheable-config  # optional
```

Auto-discovered — no manual provider or alias registration needed.

## Core concept

Add `#[Cacheable]` to a method. On the first call the real method runs and the
return value is stored in cache. On subsequent calls the cached value is
returned without executing the method body.

## Invocation styles

### 1. Transparent proxy (recommended)

Register the class in `config/cacheable.php` under `auto_proxy`. Every
container-resolved instance is then automatically wrapped — call methods
normally, caching is invisible.

```php
// config/cacheable.php
'auto_proxy' => [App\Services\UserService::class],
```

```php
// any controller / service that receives UserService via DI
$user = $this->userService->find(42); // cached automatically
```

### 2. Manual proxy

```php
use Aftandilmmd\Cacheable\Facades\Cacheable;

$service = Cacheable::proxy(new UserService());
$user = $service->find(42); // cached
```

### 3. Trait dispatcher (explicit, no proxy)

```php
use Aftandilmmd\Cacheable\Concerns\HasCacheableMethods;

class UserService {
    use HasCacheableMethods;

    #[Cacheable(ttl: 3600)]
    public function find(int $id): User { ... }
}

$service->cached('find', [42]);
```

## #[Cacheable] attribute — all parameters

| Parameter      | Type           | Default | Description |
|----------------|----------------|---------|-------------|
| key            | ?string        | null    | Key template. Supports `{paramName}` and `{param.property}` placeholders. Auto-generated when null. |
| prefix         | ?string        | config  | Prepended to the key. Falls back to `cacheable.prefix`. |
| ttl            | ?int           | config  | Seconds. null = cache forever. |
| tags           | list<string>   | []      | Tag-based grouping. Requires taggable store (redis, memcached, array). |
| store          | ?string        | config  | Override cache store (e.g. 'redis', 'memcached'). |
| keyParams      | list<string>   | []      | Whitelist: only these method params are included in key generation. |
| excludeParams  | list<string>   | []      | Blacklist: these method params are excluded from key generation. |
| when           | ?string        | null    | Method name on $this returning bool. Cache only when true. |
| unless         | ?string        | null    | Method name on $this returning bool. Skip cache when true. |
| cacheNull      | ?bool          | config  | Whether to store null return values. |
| cacheEmpty     | ?bool          | config  | Whether to store empty arrays / strings / Collections. |
| lock           | bool           | false   | Enable distributed lock for stampede protection. |
| lockWait       | ?int           | config  | Seconds to wait for lock acquisition. |
| jitter         | ?int           | config  | Random seconds added to TTL to spread expirations. |
| refreshAhead   | ?float         | config  | 0..1 fraction of TTL. Triggers background refresh within this window. |
| forget         | list<string>   | []      | Key templates to delete after this method runs. |
| forgetTags     | list<string>   | []      | Tags to flush after this method runs. |
| version        | ?string        | config  | Embedded in key. Bump to invalidate all entries globally. |
| hashAlgo       | ?string        | config  | Hash algorithm for auto-generated keys (any hash_algos() value). |
| serializer     | ?string        | config  | Argument serializer: 'json' \| 'serialize' \| 'igbinary'. |

## Common patterns

### Read method — TTL + tags
```php
#[Cacheable(key: 'user.{id}', ttl: 3600, tags: ['users'])]
public function find(int $id): User { ... }
```

### Write method — invalidate on mutation
```php
#[Cacheable(forget: ['user.{id}'], forgetTags: ['users'])]
public function update(int $id, array $data): bool { ... }
```

### Stampede protection
```php
#[Cacheable(key: 'report.{date}', ttl: 3600, lock: true, lockWait: 15)]
public function heavyReport(string $date): array { ... }
```

### Stale-while-revalidate
```php
#[Cacheable(key: 'dashboard', ttl: 600, refreshAhead: 0.2)]
public function dashboardStats(): array { ... }
```

### Conditional caching
```php
#[Cacheable(ttl: 3600, when: 'shouldCache')]
public function expensive(string $type): array { ... }

public function shouldCache(string $type): bool
{
    return $type !== 'realtime';
}
```

## Facade API

```php
use Aftandilmmd\Cacheable\Facades\Cacheable;

Cacheable::proxy($service);                           // wrap in caching proxy
Cacheable::keyFor(UserService::class, 'find', [42]);  // resolve cache key
Cacheable::forget(UserService::class, 'find', [42]);  // delete one entry
Cacheable::refresh(UserService::class, 'find', [42]); // delete + re-execute to warm cache
Cacheable::flushTags(['users']);                       // flush by tag
```

## Events

Listen in `app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php`:

| Event           | Properties                          | When |
|-----------------|-------------------------------------|------|
| CacheHit        | key, class, method, value           | Cached value returned |
| CacheMissed     | key, class, method                  | No cache — method will run |
| CacheWritten    | key, class, method, value, ttl      | Result stored in cache |
| CacheForgotten  | class, method, keys, tags           | Keys/tags invalidated |

## Extending

### Custom key resolver
```php
// app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php
$this->app->extend(KeyResolver::class, fn ($inner) =>
    new TenantAwareKeyResolver($inner)
);
```

### Custom argument normalizer
```php
$this->app->singleton(ArgumentNormalizer::class, MyNormalizer::class);
```

### Custom cache aspect
Implement `Aftandilmmd\Cacheable\Contracts\CacheAspect` and bind it.

## Configuration reference (`config/cacheable.php`)

- `enabled` — master switch, default true
- `store` — default cache store
- `prefix` — key prefix, default 'cacheable'
- `version` — global version segment, default 'v1'
- `ttl` — default TTL in seconds, default 3600
- `keys.hash_algo` — default 'xxh128'
- `keys.serializer` — default 'json'
- `keys.max_length` — default 200
- `stampede.jitter` — default 0
- `stampede.lock_wait` — default 10
- `swr.refresh_ahead` — default 0.0
- `swr.async` — enable queue-based refresh, default false
- `swr.queue_connection` — queue connection for async SWR
- `swr.queue_name` — queue name, default 'default'
- `storage.cache_null` — default false
- `storage.cache_empty` — default true
- `events.enabled` — default true
- `auto_proxy` — list of classes to auto-wrap on container resolution
